module modular_add_cipher (
    input [7:0] data_in,
    output [7:0] data_out
);

wire [8:0] c;  // Internal carry signals
wire [7:0] g;  // Generate signals
wire [7:0] p;  // Propagate signals

assign c[0] = 1'b0;  // Initial carry-in

genvar i;
generate
    for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin: adder_stage
        assign g[i] = data_in[i] & data_in[i-1];          // Generate
        assign p[i] = data_in[i] | data_in[i-1];          // Propagate
        assign c[i+1] = g[i] | (p[i] & c[i]);    // Carry-out
        assign data_out[i] = (data_in[i] ^ data_in[i-1]) ^ c[i]; // Sum bit
    end
endgenerate

endmodule

module priority_encoder_4to2 (
    input  [3:0] in,
    output [1:0] out,
    output       valid
);

assign valid   = |in;               // Valid signal is high if any input is active
assign out[1] = in[3] | in[2];     // High when D3 or D2 (with higher priority) is active
assign out[0] = in[3] | (in[1] & ~in[2]); // High when D3 or D1 (with higher priority) is active

endmodule

module up_counter8(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    output [7:0] count
);

reg [7:0] q_reg;
wire [7:0] t;

// Generate T inputs for each bit
assign t[0] = 1'b1; // T0 is always 1 (LSB)
genvar i;
generate
    for (i = 1; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin : t_gen
        assign t[i] = &(~q_reg[i-1:0]); // AND of inverted bits to the left
    end
endgenerate

// Update flip-flops on rising clock edge
always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (rst) begin
        q_reg <= 8'b0;
    end else begin
        for (integer j = 0; j < 8; j = j + 1) begin
            q_reg[j] <= q_reg[j] ^ t[j]; // Toggle if T is 1
        end
    end
end

assign count = q_reg; // Output the current count

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input enable,
  input S,
  input A,
  input B,
  input C,
  output reg Z
);

  reg [6:0] stack;

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (enable) begin
      stack <= {stack[5:0], S}; // Push S onto the stack
    end
  end

  always @(*) begin
    if (!enable) begin
      if (A) begin
        Z = stack[6]; // Pop MSB
      end else if (B) begin
        Z = stack[5];
      end else begin
        Z = C;
      end
    end else begin
      Z = stack[6];
    end
  end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input shift_ena,
  input count_ena,
  input data,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

initial begin
  q = 4'b0000;
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
  case ({shift_ena, count_ena})
    2'b00: q <= q;          // No change
    2'b01: q <= q + 1;     // Increment
    2'b10: q <= q - 1;     // Decrement
    2'b11: q <= q + (data ? 4'd3 : 4'd1); // Variable increment
  endcase
end

endmodule

module adder_8bit(
    input [7:0] a, b, 
    input cin, 
    output [7:0] sum, 
    output cout);
    
    wire [8:0] c;  // Internal carry signals
    
    assign c[0] = cin;  // Initial carry-in
    
    // Generate full adder stages using logical operations
    genvar i;
    generate
        for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin: adder_stage
            assign sum[i] = a[i] ^ b[i] ^ c[i];  // Sum bit
            assign c[i+1] = (a[i] & b[i]) | (c[i] & (a[i] ^ b[i]));  // Carry-out
        end
    endgenerate
    
    assign cout = c[8];  // Final carry-out
    
endmodule
